title: How to Heat a Swimming Pool with an Air Conditioner | Ask This Old House
summary: A This Old House segment where Richard Trethewey installs a heat exchanger that uses waste heat from a central air conditioner to heat a swimming pool.
why: HN cites it as a practical demonstration of reusing AC waste heat, in threads about heat recovery.

quote.text: It's a stainless steel coil that you can put on your A/C and then run water from your pool over it to heat the pool.
